oy: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">中古英語（蘇格蘭語）o，源自凱爾特語；同源於古愛爾蘭語 haue、aue（孫子）——另見 uncle</dd></dl>
oyster: n. 牡蠣, 蠔, 沉默者

n. marine mollusks having a rough irregular shell; found on the sea bed mostly in coastal waters
n. a small muscle on each side of the back of a fowl

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古法語 oistre，源自拉丁，再溯至希臘 ostreon</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>the world is your oyster；oyster beds</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">the world is your oyster 是慣用語，意思是你有能力、機會做想做的事</dd></dl>
oystercatcher: n. black-and-white shorebird with stout legs and bill; feed on oysters etc.
